news.title: Album transcriptions refreshed
news.body:
Re-ran [Net Worthless](?album=Net%20Worthless) with a better transcription model.

Re-ran [Closed Doors](?album=Closed%20Doors) with a better transcription model.

Re-ran [Residual Instabilities](?album=Residual%20Instabilities) and [Failure to Converge](?album=Failure%20to%20Converge) with a better transcription model.

news.title: Misfiled Weather timed lyrics cleaned up
news.body:
Cleaned up the timed lyrics for [Misfiled Weather](?album=Broken%20Temple&song=Misfiled%20Weather) so repeated transcription ad-libs no longer appear in its lyric data.

Added scoped timing anchors for the same track so Verse 2 continues advancing smoothly instead of pausing and then skipping ahead.

Adjusted the bridge timing so "ASD came later" waits until the vocal arrives instead of advancing during the preceding ad-lib gap.

Fixed the intro timing for [Broken Temple](?album=Broken%20Temple&song=Broken%20Temple) so the first lyric line advances normally instead of holding until the title line.

Regenerated the same track's timed lyrics with a larger GPU-backed transcription model so Verse 1 now keeps advancing after "in the body-country."

Added a 3D museum view where the discography appears as chronological album rooms. Visitors can walk through the wood-toned construction space, play songs from room stations, and see timed lyrics inside the 3D view.

Adjusted the 3D museum rooms so albums with more songs have longer rooms, giving dense track labels more space while keeping shorter albums at a comfortable minimum size.

Reduced the size of the 3D museum mobile controls and player overlays so the view is easier to use on smaller phones.

Improved the site header on narrow screens so navigation buttons wrap into reachable rows instead of being clipped.

news.title: News links keep playback running
news.body:
News article links now use the site's in-page routing, so opening albums or songs from News no longer reloads the page or interrupts the player.

Fixed the timed lyrics for [Fair Wind Clause](?album=Driftwood&song=Fair%20Wind%20Clause) with word-level alignment, so lyric highlighting follows the song more accurately.

Added [Broken Temple](?album=Broken%20Temple) to the catalogue with analysis reports and timed lyrics.

news.title: Catalogue re-analyzed with upgraded review model
news.body: Fixed an analyzer issue, switched the LLM adjustment pass to Gemma 4 12B with audio-aware review, and re-analyzed every song in the catalogue. Song scores and report details now reflect the refreshed analysis.

news.title: Report assets restored for source previews
news.body:
Added the generated report JSON assets to the gh-pages source output and updated the site builder so refreshed source previews include those reports. Song pages now load full report data when serving gh-pages directly instead of falling back to catalog summary data. Fixed the GitHub Pages artifact build so it copies committed gh-pages report JSON files when local analysis-output reports are not present in CI.

Recovered track: restored the original Oars From Strangers recording and lyrics as [Old Oars From Strangers](?album=Lost%20Souls&song=Old%20Oars%20From%20Strangers) in [Lost Souls](?album=Lost%20Souls). The remade version remains available as [Oars From Strangers](?album=Driftwood&song=Oars%20From%20Strangers) in [Driftwood](?album=Driftwood).

Added [Homeostasis](?album=Lost%20Souls&song=Homeostasis) to [Lost Souls](?album=Lost%20Souls), with analysis and timed lyrics.

news.title: News section added
news.body: Added a News section as the default landing view, renamed the statistics view to Discography, and added navigation between News and Discography. Regenerated Oars From Strangers timed lyrics with word timestamps and added scoped final-chorus overrides so the lyrics recover from the 3:26 ad-lib at 3:39. Split the large catalog payload into a small manifest plus separate frameworks, statistics, and albums data files so the catalog is easier to edit and review. Split the gh-pages frontend into separate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files, and added query-param routing for the Discography view, album pages, and song reports. Song report pages now fall back to catalog summary data when the full report JSON is unavailable. Added Copy Link buttons to album and song pages so their routed URLs can be shared directly. Updated the site build so the deployable _site output includes the split CSS and JavaScript assets.
